Refreshed the quickstart against the current console, replaced every screenshot, and added a note at the top pointing existing integrators at the migration appendix instead.

The support rotation calendar drifted from the actual roster again; two people who left the team are still listed on upcoming weeks. Sync it from the roster source of truth and set it to regenerate weekly instead of being hand-edited.
Synced the rotation calendar from the roster and scheduled the weekly regeneration; hand edits now get overwritten on the next sync, which is the point.

Stabilized the comparison by pinning its input window; the suite is green again and the flake ticket has the analysis attached for the record.

Built the migration tracking page with producer counts by generation and linked it from the flip runbook; the observer confirmed it covers what they need.
